description: A shell script for testing git-cvsserver with various configurations, including handling of binary and text files, attributes, and repository operations.

methods.name: marked_as
methods.description: Checks if a file is marked with the expected attribute (-kb or default) in CVS Entries.

methods.name: not_present
methods.description: Verifies that a file is not present in CVS Entries or the filesystem.

methods.name: check_status_options
methods.description: Checks the CVS status options for a file, particularly sticky options.
